title: KCSAN: data-race in __es_find_extent_range / __es_find_extent_range (6)
two_threads_summary: KCSAN-reported two-context race. KCSAN: data-race in __es_find_extent_range / __es_find_extent_range (6)
audit_notes: Subject: 'ext4: fix data races when using cached status extents'. Pre-classifier PROBABLY_GOOD (real synchronization primitives on + lines).
fix_commit_message:
492888df0c7b42fc0843631168b0021bc4caee84
ext4: fix data races when using cached status extents

When using cached extent stored in extent status tree in tree->cache_es
another process holding ei->i_es_lock for reading can be racing with us
setting new value of tree->cache_es. If the compiler would decide to
refetch tree->cache_es at an unfortunate moment, it could result in a
bogus in_range() check. Fix the possible race by using READ_ONCE() when
using tree->cache_es only under ei->i_es_lock for reading.
